name: Tanning and spray tan

pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: spray tanning has no state license in most places; a technician's certificate or training is the business's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
pf.license.who: the business, for any registration it chooses to show; each tech's certificate is their own word
pf.license.ask: optional: a registration number or a certificate the business wants shown; nothing is asked of each tech
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate or insurance for this work (not on any lookup, not by the team)
pf.license.certificates: a tanning certificate or training is shown as the tech's own word, never as a license
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license or certificate blocks a booking here
pf.license.renewals: none checked; a date on a certificate is only a reminder the business sets itself
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; shown only if the business chooses
pf.license.background: any background check is the business's own policy, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.claims: no skin-cure or medical claims: a spray tan is a cosmetic service, never a treatment for skin

pf.services.shape: one spray tan per visit, with a tech the client picks or any free one; packs of tans; a home or venue visit for a party
pf.services.examples: the example businesses' own prices (Lee Tan Studio and Lee Mobile Tan), not a standard

list.name: Express spray tan
list.length: 20 min, plus 10 min to clean the booth
list.before: a card saved for the $20 fee
list.note: disposable underwear; eyes and lips protected

list.name: 5-tan pack (express)
list.before: paid in full when booked, on the secure page or at the desk

list.name: Mobile spray tan at home
list.where: at the client's home or hotel
list.before: a card saved for the $50 fee

list.name: Express mobile tan, paid in full
Bridal party for 5, at a venue
list.after: the rest billed after the tans

list.name: Extra area (add-on)
list.length: added to a tan, same time
list.where: at the studio or at home
list.after: at the front desk, or on the bill

pf.services.travel: a home visit is included in the price inside the 25-mile area (the example's setting); a travel fee for farther towns where Sam sets one
pf.services.capacity: one tech per tan; a bridal party is one booking with several people, each with their own form
pf.services.skills: express, full-body and bridal spray tans in light, medium and dark shades; eye and lip protection; no DHA tan for a client whose form names an allergy
pf.services.online: no: a spray tan is done in person
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the client must be there

beforeTimes: the tan wanted (express, full-body or bridal) and the shade wanted (light, medium or dark)
a tech by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
at home or at a venue: the town, the place, and how many people
for a bridal party: the date and the time of the wedding
afterTime: areas to skip (a tattoo, a patch on the face, a fresh scar)
at home or at a venue: parking, stairs, and a private room with a chair and a changing space
securePage: 18 or older (no tan is booked for anyone under 18)
the tan form: skin conditions, allergies (to DHA or other ingredients), any rash or sunburn, pregnancy or nursing, medicines that make skin sensitive, and a recent peel, laser or waxing
a bridal party: each person's own form
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult, for themselves or another adult; nobody under 18 (the example's setting)

stop.words: a rash, blisters, hives, swelling, burning skin, a skin infection, or an open sore or cut in the area
stop.say: Please don't book a spray tan now. See a doctor if your skin is sore or burning.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK

stop.words: trouble breathing, chest pain, or fainting
stop.say: This could be an emergency. Call 911 now. A tan can wait.

refuse.words: a request for sexual services, or to be sprayed in a way that is sexual
refuse.say: This studio offers spray tans only. This request can't be booked.
refuse.what: the exact words go to the business's safety log; Sam picks: refuse and block that chat or number, or it was innocent and a tan may be booked (every later message is checked again); no reply in 2 of Sam's text hours: nothing is booked

goOn.words: a sunburn or a peeling area
goOn.what: the tech skips that area; the tan goes on
the visit moves with no fee

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Tan form
steps.when: on the secure page before the first tan (due when booking, inside the saved 10 minutes); a returning client confirms by the day before
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until the skin changes
steps.result: most answers change nothing; a flag (an allergy to DHA, a rash, pregnancy or nursing) goes to the tech to read before the booking is kept

steps.name: Tech's read of a flag
steps.when: before the booking is written, in the tech's text hours; no answer in 1 hour: Sam reads it
steps.result: OK as booked; OK with a note (a lighter shade, eyes and lips covered); a doctor's OK first; or no, with the reason kept private

pf.first_steps.prep: shower and shave 6 hours before; no lotion or deodorant on the day; wear a bathing suit or disposable underwear; eyes and lips are protected; at home: a private room with a chair and a towel

pf.visit.checkIn: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; at home or a venue: the code at the door, from the client who booked
pf.visit.beforeWork: the tech goes over the tan form and the shade with the client before the spray; the client changes alone into disposable underwear, and gets eye and lip protection; the tech leaves the room during the spray if the client asks
pf.visit.changes: a shade change or an extra area is priced and OK'd before it's done
pf.visit.stop: the tech may end a tan at any time for a reaction; Sam decides any charge (only what the client agreed to) and any block; it goes in the safety log
pf.visit.away: only techs Sam allows go to homes or venues; the tech's DONE is the check-out: no DONE 15 minutes after the booked end, Rosie texts, then calls the tech, then tells Sam with the address
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the tech; the tech's notes (shade, areas, reactions) go in the client's private record

pf.money.before: at the studio: a card saved for the $20 late-cancel and no-show fee; a 5-tan pack paid in full when bought; at home or at a venue: a card saved for the $50 fee; a bridal party's $100 deposit when booked, and the rest billed after
pf.money.caps: deposit and fee caps: the business's own; a deposit is never more than the price, and a fee is never more than what was paid now
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before at the studio, and until 7am the day of a visit at home or a venue (the owner's settings)
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $20 at the studio; $50 at home; a bridal party keeps its $100 deposit; Sam confirms each fee, never more than what was agreed or paid now
pf.money.conduct: a tan ended for the client's conduct: charged only what the booking page said, and only if Sam says so
pf.money.packs: packs of tans and gift cards: sold at the studio, or on the secure page where Sam turns it on; a visit uses one tan
pf.money.tips: on: at the front desk, or a tip line on the bill Rosie texts; tips go to the tech in full
pf.money.tax: a tax line where the state's rules tax the service or the product
pf.money.insurance: none: the studio bills no health plan or insurance

pf.messages.never: skin answers, allergies, pregnancy, medicines, a doctor's note and the tech's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
pf.messages.tone: no words that promise a skin result, a cure or a medical effect; a spray tan is a cosmetic service
pf.messages.minors: nobody under 18 is booked; Rosie never texts a minor

pf.staff.licenses: no state license for spray tanning in most places; a certificate or training is each tech's own word, shown only if they choose; never checked by Rosie (D96)
pf.staff.skills: express, full-body and bridal spray tans in light, medium and dark shades; eye and lip protection; no DHA tan for a client whose form names an allergy
pf.staff.gender: each tech's gender is set only so a client can ask for a woman or a man; a filter used only when the client asks
pf.staff.supervision: a trainee works only with a named tech in the room, where the business sets it (none in the example)
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs same-day tans and new clients at the studio; he can set every home or venue visit to ask him first; a health flag goes to the booked tech, then to Sam after 1 hour
pf.staff.standIn: a stand-in must fit the shade and the tan booked, and gets the tan form and notes
pf.staff.away: only techs Sam allows are offered for homes and venues

pf.rules.showLicense: no license claim on listings, times or confirmations; the business's own registration shows only if it has one
pf.rules.draping: the client wears disposable underwear and eye and lip protection; a request for a tan without them is refused
pf.rules.hours: no tans in hours the business has not set (the example's own hours)
pf.rules.away: home and venue visits only inside the 25-mile area, and only where Sam allows the tech
pf.rules.minors: 18 or older only, with no exception; a bridal party's guests each book as adults
pf.rules.reset: 10 minutes between clients to clean the booth (the example studio's setting)
pf.rules.records: tan forms and notes kept 7 years

pf.edges.improper: a request for sexual services: refused, logged and sent to Sam (pf.safety)
pf.edges.lateArrival: the tan starts when the client arrives, at full price; at the studio, no word 15 minutes after the start is a no-show
pf.edges.runsLate: the tech runs late: the client keeps the full time if the next booking and the 10-minute clean still fit; if not, a new time with no fee
pf.edges.standIn: a stand-in who fits the shade and the tan booked, with the form and notes; or new times with no fee
pf.edges.healthChange: a new reaction or change in skin before the tan: the client updates the form; the tech decides; a move has no fee
pf.edges.conduct: a tan ended for the client's conduct: Sam decides any charge (only what was agreed) and any block
pf.edges.awaySafety: the safety check-out after visits at a home or a venue
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
